Would Redwood be open to an after-hours "concierge" session — likely a compact 75–90 minute slot that covers the three items back-to-back?

- Want one meeting we can record for internal stakeholders, but also need live screen-share for evidence mapping and the pen vendor to ask questions
- Need an upload location for evidence and a short pre-walkthrough agenda

Do you have a teammate who can lead the call at that time (we can be flexible by ±30 minutes)? If so, please propose 2–3 contiguous slots and an agenda. Also please flag any documents you prefer we share ahead of time.

Thanks — Jordan

- Option B: 2026-05-06 00:30–02:00 UTC (17:30–19:00 PDT / 02:30–04:00 CEST)

1) 10m — Introductions & goals (customer asks + success criteria)
2) 25m — SOC 2 controls mapping + where Redwood stores logs and artifacts
3) 20m — Pen test scope discussion & vendor access model (what we allow, remote/SSH/no access etc.)
4) 15m — DPA clauses and evidence handoff (retention + encryption + KMS)
5) 5m — Next steps / upload instructions

Attachments: SOC2-Concise-Agenda.pdf (attached), redwood-evidence-playbook.pdf (attached). Olga will share a short evidence upload guide and a Drive folder link if you confirm a slot.

Let me know which option you prefer and whether 75 minutes is OK. If you prefer, Camila can run a 20-minute dry run just for the pen vendor and internal engineers to speed things up.
